Name: Magic Buff Beans
Author: vincott
Description:
Perhaps, you got some magic beans for the cow. Good of you! 

Magic beans that grant all buffs available in the game and are the best all-around gift. They grow for 5 days all year round and continue to yield a harvest after being picked. There are 4 variants available: regular, gold, iridium, and radioactive (which differ in the strength of their effects).
